**1. Global Risk Regime?**

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals and niche risk-on pockets leading: XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +13.79%), XLI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.77% | 1M: +5.89%), XLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.72% | 1M: +5.26%). Tech lagging: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.54% | 1M: -0.19%); style mixed with cyclical tilt.

**5. US vs Global?**

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Bifurcated: Biotech risk-on with XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +13.79%) versus crypto risk-off—IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -7.81% | 1M: -22.03%) and ETHA BELOW TREND (1W: -10.18% | 1M: -24.84%).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals under pressure: GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -4.93% | 1M: -10.76%) and SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -13.61% | 1M: -24.90%); industrial metals soft with CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -5.25%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy weak overall: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -5.83%) and BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -21.13%), while natural gas strength stands out with UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +7.70%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: XBI, XLI, XLV ABOVE TREND showing pockets of leadership. DIVERGENCE: XLF in CORRECTION (1W: -0.76% | 1M: +3.45%) and several correction/recovery alerts (ITA CORRECTION, EWJ CORRECTION) — overall divergence is MINOR (not across core SPY/XLK/TLT trio).

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals and selective growth pockets (XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +13.79%), XLI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.77% | 1M: +5.89%)); reduce exposure to broad tech risk (XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.54% | 1M: -0.19%)) and monitor duration via TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +3.05%).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +13.79%), XLI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.77% | 1M: +5.89%), XLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.72% | 1M: +5.26%). BEARISH: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.54% | 1M: -0.19%), FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -10.72%), GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -4.93% | 1M: -10.76%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +7.70%). BEARISH: BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -21.13%), SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -13.61% | 1M: -24.90%), CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -5.25%).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -1.23% | 1M: -9.32%) — watch ~20 for complacency. HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +0.14%) / LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +1.04%) — HYG/LQD near 0.80 flags credit health. XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +13.79%) — monitor for follow-through above recent highs. IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -7.81% | 1M: -22.03%) — watch for downside momentum.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +13.79%) and XLI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.77% | 1M: +5.89%) showing relative strength while XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.54% | 1M: -0.19%) and FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -10.72%) show weakness. Key risk is the divergence between small-cap outperformance IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.12% | 1M: +3.14%) and broad-market softness SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -1.92%) — monitor XLF CORRECTION (1W: -0.76% | 1M: +3.45%).
